title: Telemetry coverage — endpoint process-creation
summary: Share of in-scope endpoints emitting host process-creation telemetry over the evaluation window. A direct measure of how much of the estate the vuln_intake playbook can see into.

target.rationale: Coverage floor below which detection latency degrades nonlinearly.

measurement.formula: 100 * count(distinct device.hostname with >=1 process_create event in window) / count(distinct in-scope endpoints).
